title: "Can you just make me a meal plan?"
hook: "Can you just make me a meal plan?"
caption:
"Can you just make me a meal plan?"

I get asked that all the time.

Earlier in my career, that's exactly what I did. I'd create a customized plan, hand it to the client, and think:

They wouldn't follow it. I'd ask why. They'd explain. I'd tell them why they needed to follow it.

title: Eating well becomes a lot easier when you don’t have to figure it out from scratch every day.
hook: Eating well becomes a lot easier when you don’t have to figure it out from scratch every day.
caption:
Eating well becomes a lot easier when you don’t have to figure it out from scratch every day.

Here are 5 things I’d start with 👇

1️⃣ HAVE A FEW GO-TO MEALS
Find meals you enjoy that fit your goals and are easy to make. You don’t need a different breakfast every morning.

2️⃣ KEEP THE EASY OPTIONS IN THE HOUSE
Eggs, Greek yoghurt, microwave rice, frozen veg and cooked chicken. A decent meal doesn’t have to involve an hour in the kitchen.

3️⃣ COOK EXTRA WHEN YOU’RE ALREADY COOKING
Making dinner? Make enough for tomorrow’s lunch too. Same effort with another meal sorted.

But Type 1 Diabetes IS a huge part of my everyday life.

And honestly, I wish I saw more Type 1 diabetics represented in the fitness world, especially people willing to openly talk about what it takes to train while managing this disease 24/7.

Because we belong here too.

Powerlifting. Bodybuilding. Strongman. CrossFit. Running. Competing. Chasing PRs. Building muscle. Becoming athletes.

We can do ALL of it. 💪🏼💙

title: Language is leadership.
hook: Language is leadership.
caption:
Language is leadership.

Change the narrative.
Change the outcome.

When I’m coaching people, I listen to how they talk about their training. The words we use can shape what we do next.

Here’s what I say when these things come up:

“My training is boring.”
→ Boring is great. Consistency doesn’t need to be exciting.

“My progress is slow.”
→ Slow is still progress. Give yourself credit for moving forward.

“I keep doing the basics.”

title: I studied 1,000 Instagram funnels. These are the 6 that actually sell 👇
hook: I studied 1,000 Instagram funnels. These are the 6 that actually sell 👇
caption:
I studied 1,000 Instagram funnels. These are the 6 that actually sell 👇

1️⃣ Buy Now: post, link, sell. Best for offers under ₹2,000.
2️⃣ Call: for ₹25,000+ offers. The money is in the follow-up.
3️⃣ Waitlist: open doors once a month. Real urgency, real sales.
4️⃣ DM: “Comment WORD” + automation + a real conversation.
5️⃣ Webinar: give them the hour. Most sales come after it.
6️⃣ Community: a free group that sells your paid offer for you.

You don’t need all six. You need the right one for your price point.

Which one are you running right now? Tell me in the comments 👇
